audience: finance and expense teams who read receipts and invoices with Taggun OCR

useCases.title: Read the data of a receipt or invoice from a link
useCases.text: The AI scans a receipt or invoice at a public https URL (JPEG, PNG, GIF, HEIC or PDF) and returns merchant, date, total, tax and, in verbose mode, line items.

useCases.title: Read the data of a receipt sent as file data
useCases.text: The AI scans a small receipt image or PDF given as base64 text and returns merchant, date, total and tax for your expense entry.

useCases.title: Check a receipt against a validation campaign
useCases.text: The AI scans a receipt at a URL and checks it against the rules of a stored campaign. You get pass or fail with reasons.

useCases.title: Review the rules of a validation campaign
useCases.text: The AI lists the campaigns on the account and reads the rules of one: dates, merchants, products, fraud checks and SmartValidate prompts.

useCases.title: Export the product categories, merchants or product codes
useCases.text: The AI reads the reference data of the account as CSV: the category list, known merchants with locations, or expected product codes.
